summary: Multi-position tiled acquisition. Required for the Tiling widget.

fields.label: XY Positioner
fields.tip: Stage that moves between tile centres (must match a positioner in the setup).

fields.label: Z Positioner (opt.)
fields.tip: Z positioner used for per-tile autofocus. Leave empty to disable.

fields.label: Align on (opt.)
fields.tip: Detector used for tile alignment. Empty = first forAcquisition detector.

fields.label: Detector transforms
fields.tip: Optional. How each additionally saved detector's pixels relate to the aligned-on one, e.g. {"APD1": "identity"} after confirming pixel registration. Detectors left out are still saved, recorded as 'unknown'.

fields.label: Default tile step (µm)
fields.tip: Default stage step between tile centres, in micrometres.

fields.label: Default tiles X
fields.tip: Default grid width. Equal to Y opens the widget with its square lock on.

fields.label: Default pattern
fields.tip: spiral = grows outward from the current position, stoppable early with a centred mosaic. serpentine = rasters from the current position in +X/+Y, no move longer than one tile step.
